summary: Cortexel: an agent-consumable scientific-visualization contract for neural simulations. An agent emits a declarative VizSpec or FigureRequestV1; Cortexel validates it, routes it to a scene, and enforces fail-closed honesty provenance. CLAUDE.md is the contributor contract and AGENTS.md guides agents that use Cortexel; this index restates the contributor facts for tools.
